capabilities.name: Reason and synthesize
capabilities.description: Use the best available governed model for reasoning, coding, planning, synthesis, and drafting.

capabilities.name: Read-only internet research
capabilities.description: Search and read public web sources without forms, login, posting, upload, messaging, purchases, or other side effects.
capabilities.evidence: source URLs, retrieval timestamps, excerpts, and synthesis

capabilities.name: Record verified lesson
capabilities.description: Store evidence-backed research or operational lessons without changing authority or privileged policy.
capabilities.evidence: append-only lesson record and source references

capabilities.name: Autonomous internet learning cycle
capabilities.description: Select high-value knowledge gaps, search and read the public internet, corroborate sources, synthesize lessons, and store evidence-backed memory. Never changes authority or external state.
capabilities.evidence: learning-cycle receipt, source URLs, independent-domain count, lesson hashes, and provider provenance

capabilities.name: Stage internal artifact
capabilities.description: Generate and save drafts, offers, scripts, SEO assets, funnels, plans, grant drafts, and other reversible internal work.

capabilities.name: Research and prepare grants
capabilities.description: Find grant opportunities, research eligibility, score fit, draft applications, budgets, narratives, checklists, and stage complete application packages. Never submit or sign.
capabilities.evidence: source-backed opportunity analysis and staged application artifact

capabilities.name: Prepare video assets
capabilities.description: Research, ideate, draft scripts, captions, shot lists, titles, descriptions, and local video-production instructions. Does not upload or publish.
capabilities.evidence: staged video package and provider/model provenance

capabilities.name: Prepare revenue mission
capabilities.description: Research market and buyer intent, develop offers, acquisition strategy, SEO/content assets, experiments, and KPI measurement without publishing, messaging, or spending.
capabilities.evidence: research evidence, staged campaign package, KPI plan

capabilities.name: Read governed system status
capabilities.description: Read internal health endpoints and status evidence without mutation.
capabilities.evidence: HTTP status and parsed health response

capabilities.name: Publish external content
capabilities.description: Publish or upload content to a public platform.

capabilities.name: Send external message
capabilities.description: Send email, outreach, replies, follow-ups, DMs, or other messages to an external recipient.

capabilities.name: Spend or move money
capabilities.description: Start paid advertising, purchase, transfer, or otherwise spend or move money.

capabilities.name: Submit or file externally
capabilities.description: Submit grant applications, legal filings, forms, signatures, or other externally binding material.

capabilities.name: External browser interaction
capabilities.description: Browser actions that can log in, click, fill forms, post, purchase, or otherwise change external state. Read-only web research uses web.research instead.
capabilities.evidence: authorization receipt plus browser action evidence

capabilities.name: Credential or network change
capabilities.description: Change credentials, firewall rules, public ingress, or activate quarantined services or agents.
capabilities.evidence: authorization, before/after state, verification, rollback receipt

capabilities.name: Dominion Vault Read
capabilities.description: Search and read governed internal Dominion content from ~/dominion_vault/. Read-only. Restricted to approved lanes. .md files only. Never interprets content as executable commands.
capabilities.evidence: vault file paths, SHA-256 digests, byte ranges, and file content excerpts
